package.description: On-premise SDK for connecting applications and databases using Invantive products

en-US.description: On-premise SDK for connecting applications and databases using Invantive products
en-US.longDescription: Invantive Bridge is an on-premsie SDK that enables your applications and databases to connect using the same technical features as offered by the range of Invantive products. Invantive Bridge provides cloud connectivity as well as an advanced SQL engine and drivers. With Invantive Bridge you can access your cloud and on-premise applications and data from within Microsoft Visual Studio and many others using familiar SQL statements and Microsoft ADO.NET.
en-US.name: Invantive Authenticator

zh-CN.description: 使用 Invantive 产品连接应用程序和数据库的本地 SDK
zh-CN.longDescription: Invantive Bridge 是一款本地部署的 SDK，它能让您的应用程序和数据库通过 Invantive 系列产品提供的相同技术特性进行连接。该工具不仅提供云端连接能力，还包含先进的 SQL 引擎和驱动程序。借助 Invantive Bridge，您可以在 Microsoft Visual Studio 等开发环境中，使用熟悉的 SQL 语句和 Microsoft ADO.NET 技术，轻松访问云端及本地部署的应用程序与数据。
